evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To evaluate this regime, we introduce \textbf{\datasetname}, a realistic multi-instance benchmark.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across \datasetname, PerSeg, PerMIS, and DAVIS, our system surpasses PerSAM, $\mathrm{P}^2\mathrm{SAM}$, and PDM by up to $\sim\!48$ mIoU while matching their runtime and using fewer parameters, establishing a strong, deployable training-free baseline for real-world personalized segmentation.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: For robust matching we propose \textbf{top-$K$ Sinkhorn}, a patch-level distance that scores each candidate only on its most confidently matched patches; trimming the Sinkhorn dual potentials recovers the robustness of partial optimal transport at more than $100\times$ lower cost, keeping it inside the per-proposal candidate loop.
